visual_review.crop_utility: Sharp daylight historic exterior; the facade, readable sign, and roof arches survive a focused portrait crop.

recommended_vertical_crop.treatment: Slow push-in or small horizontal pan; optional neutral exposure/white-balance correction only; no retouching, logo extraction, recoloring, or animation.

visual_review.trademark_editorial_context: Golden Arches and McDonald's wordmark are static, unmodified, contextual elements of the photographed restaurant. Informational identification only; no endorsement, standalone logo use, or advertising implication.

visual_review.crop_utility: High-resolution modern exterior with clean sky, readable facade, and roadside sign; the subject remains legible in a portrait crop.

recommended_vertical_crop.treatment: Gentle vertical pan from facade to sign; optional neutral exposure/white-balance correction only. Preserve the photograph and context; if published cropped, state that it was cropped for vertical framing.
